objective: Continue the walk from the accepted first segment: the subject keeps moving through the corridor while the camera tracks alongside, and the take ends mid-stride so a third segment can continue from it.

characters.name: Kage
characters.description: Adult courier, medium build, close-cropped dark hair, carrying a canvas satchel on the left shoulder
characters.identity_anchor: Facial structure, the scar through the right eyebrow, and the satchel strap crossing right-shoulder-to-left-hip
characters.costume: Charcoal work jacket over a grey shirt, dark trousers, worn boots

identity_constraints.constraint: Scar through the right eyebrow remains visible whenever the face is toward camera
Satchel stays on the left shoulder and does not switch sides

environment.description: A service corridor, concrete floor, pipework along the left wall, intermittent ceiling strip-lights
environment.spatial_layout: Corridor runs left to right across frame; subject moves right; camera holds on the subject's left side at roughly two metres

depth_layers.description: Foreground: pipework passing through frame left, occluding the subject briefly
Background: the corridor receding, strip-lights repeating toward a far door

foreground_elements.name: Wall pipework
foreground_elements.description: Horizontal pipes crossing the frame, passing camera-left as the camera moves

background_elements.name: Far door
background_elements.description: A closed door at the corridor's end, remaining closed for the whole take

props.name: Canvas satchel
props.description: Worn canvas bag, strap across the body, swinging slightly with the gait

lighting.description: Overhead strip-lights producing repeating pools of light and shadow as the subject advances

atmosphere.description: Cool, still air; faint haze catching the strip-lights

material_behavior.behavior: swings with a delay of roughly a quarter stride behind the body, never passing through the jacket
creases at the elbow on each arm swing and settles between strides

camera_state.framing: medium shot, subject at roughly one-third frame width, head near the upper third line

camera_motion.subject_framing_note: holding the subject at approximately one-third frame width throughout, matching the subject's walking speed rather than drifting ahead or behind

lens_behavior.focus_behavior: focus stays on the subject; the passing foreground pipework goes soft rather than pulling focus

subject_motion.action: walks at a steady pace, roughly 1.4 metres per second, arms swinging in counterphase to the legs
subject_motion.phase_at_start: mid-stride, left foot in contact, right leg swinging forward
subject_motion.phase_at_end: mid-stride, right foot in contact, left leg swinging forward

secondary_motion.behavior: swings in response to the gait, lagging the body

physics_expectations.subject: kage
physics_expectations.expectation: Feet make and break contact with the floor without sliding; no foot penetrates the floor plane

physics_expectations.subject: satchel
physics_expectations.expectation: Swings under gravity and is constrained by the strap; it does not intersect the body

animation_timing.description: Steady gait cycle of roughly 1.1 seconds per full stride

rhythm.description: Even and unhurried; no acceleration or hesitation within the take

audio_state.description: Footsteps on concrete with corridor reverb, faint ventilation hum
audio_state.phase_note: The footstep on the first frame lands mid-step, continuing the cadence from the previous segment rather than restarting it

narrative_state.description: The courier is partway along the corridor, still carrying the undelivered package
unresolved: The package has not been delivered
The far door has not been reached

visual_style.description: Naturalistic, handheld-free, neutral colour with a slight cool cast from the strip-lights

reference_bindings.rationale: Preserve the courier's face and build across segments
The accepted previous segment is hard temporal history; the gait phase and camera speed continue from it
Keep the corridor geometry and light spacing identical to the established location

continuity_constraints.constraint: The first frame continues the gait cycle from the previous segment's terminal state: left foot in contact, right leg swinging
Camera lateral velocity matches the previous segment's terminal velocity; there is no restart, stop or re-acceleration at the cut
The satchel remains on the left shoulder, mid-swing, as it was at the previous terminal frame

negative_constraints.forbid: the subject stopping, turning to camera, or acknowledging the camera
negative_constraints.rationale: Breaks the observational framing and forecloses continuation

negative_constraints.forbid: the far door opening or anyone else entering the corridor
negative_constraints.rationale: Introduces an unplanned narrative event the next segment has not accounted for

negative_constraints.forbid: a cut, dissolve or fade within the take
negative_constraints.rationale: The segment must be one continuous camera take

verification_requirements.rationale: Identity drift across segments is the failure this chain most needs to prevent
The first frame must be causally compatible with the previous terminal state
The take must leave an extendable state for the third segment
Artifacts compound across a chained sequence
